page.layout: One page of running text, with margin notes in the right margin (three notes: Exod.17.15. beside line 3, Ezech.48. beside line 4, and a section number 35 beside line 5). Running head above the text. At the foot: signature Dd iiij. at left, catchword at right.

main_text.p: men ad ea monumenta transferri,in quibus se fi-delibus suis adesse testatus est,ut cum Moyses al-tare extructum nominat Iehovah vexillum suu: Exod.17.15. Ezechiel Hierusalem vocat Iehovah illic. Sed ve-Ezech.48.lint nolint fateri coguntur, nomen Immanuelis 35specialem quandam Dei praesentiam in Christo nobis exhibitam significare ab universali multũ diversam, qua ante ejus adventum populo Israelitico sese patefecerat. Nam si tunc hujus nominis ratio vere constare coepit,cum apparuit Christus in carne,sequitur olim non in solidum, sed ex parte tantum Deum conjunctum fuisse cum patribus. Unde certissime confici potest, Christum esse Deum in carne patefactum. Deinde si nihil nisi homo hic Immanuel esset,quorsum attinebat propheta sequenti versu de butyro & melle,quibus hic puer educandus erat, deque incremento judicii ac sensuum mentionem facere? Voluit certe propheta ista restrictione innuere, Immanuelem hunc verum quidem Deum fore, sed & verum hominem, qui butyrum & mel comedat,cibum infantibus nutriendis consuetum, qui fastiditis amaris, suavibus delectetur & recreetur: qui denique certa animi & corporis incrementa sit habiturus. Quare ut cibus & pueritia incrementa corporis & intelligentiae, verum hominem arguunt: Sic Immanuel verum & aeternum Deum convincit. Quid? quod in tota sacra Scriptura beneficia, quae, unico Messiae tanquam fonti & authori tribuuntur, non sunt finitae aut creatae potentiae, sed solius Dei opera propria,ut sunt:colligere sibi ex universo genere hu-

page.notes: Printed note numbers beside the text: "Exod.17.15." and "Ezech.48." are clear enough; "Ezech.48." is read from a small, partly obscured reference, so verify. The mark "35" beside "Immanuelis" is small and may be a section or note number rather than a marginal reference; read with doubt. The catchword "mano" is at the right foot; it may be "manu" in the printing, so it is marked [?]. Word "multũ" carries a tilde as printed. Long s in "potest" is written as plain s per the rules.
